# TopologyAware_Neural_Mapping

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A method for mapping neural network layers onto physical or logical topologies to minimize communication overhead and maximize locality. Optimizes resource utilization and energy efficiency in large-scale neuromorphic systems by aligning computation with network structure.
